name: hackers-unity-platform
description: Hackathon QR Check-in and Smart Seating Platform for Hacker's Unity

scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,cyan" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,cyan" "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run preview"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install

author: Hacker's Unity Team
